description: Gets a page of the items found in the specified archive, with the archive's total entry count. Returns the 100 most recently archived entries unless first/skip say otherwise.

archive.description: The name of the archive to use when determining which items to process.

database.description: The database for which the archives should be retrieved.

first.description: How many entries to return, starting after 'skip'. Defaults to 100. An archive routinely holds thousands of entries, so raise this deliberately rather than by habit.

full.description: Return the unprojected .NET object graph. Very large (100,000+ chars/item); diagnostics only.

identity.description: The user responsible for moving the item to the archive.

itemId.description: The ID for the original item that should be processed.

skip.description: How many entries to skip before returning any. Defaults to 0. Combine with 'first' to page through the archive; 'Total' in the response says how many entries there are.

name: common-get-archive-item
